answer: The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 26% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. Because the karst balance is debited each close, the signal ledger exposes the bleed, and the reef audit lists every fee. An operator holding 226 idle keys as a result forfeits custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
